summary: Deploy bundle is consistent and ready to ship. FILES arrays in deploy.sh and .github/workflows/deploy.yml mirror byte-for-byte (13 elements, identical order). All four new files added by the llm-transcreation feature are included: claude_transcreation.py, compute_publish_slots.py, outage_state.py (cron-side runtime modules — without any of them news_bot crashes with ImportError) and ux-guidelines.md (Claude API system prompt — Decision 8 flat-fallback in _load_prompt covers the scp-flatten quirk). Idempotent .env-write step is correctly placed between Copy files and pip install. Stale 12h/hourly cron comments fixed in both deploy.sh and deploy.yml. PK docs (architecture.md, patterns.md, deployment.md) reflect the new daily-12:00-МСК + distributed-publish + Claude-API model with operator-actionable runbook content.

findings.issue: FILES list extended from 9 → 13 entries with the four new items in the order specified by Task 13 (three .py modules grouped with cron-side runtime imports, ux-guidelines.md as last element). Headline comment explicitly notes the invariant ('any new first-party import → in FILES of both files') and the scp-flatten quirk for ux-guidelines.md (Decision 8 fallback in _load_prompt). Headline 'hourly cron path' replaced with 'daily 12:00 МСК cron path'.

FILES array mirrors deploy.sh byte-for-byte. Headline comment explicitly cross-references deploy.sh and the invariant. The pre-existing per-file `test -f` check still applies and will fail-fast if any FILES element is missing in the repo.

Step is correctly placed AFTER Copy files (so .env exists if not already) and BEFORE pip install. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_MODEL/TZ are passed via `env:` (Actions auto-redaction). Inline heredoc form streams values over ssh stdin; remote shell uses bash builtins only. Idempotent: grep -v cleanup of the three managed keys before append → repeat-deploy preserves all unrelated keys verbatim and keeps each managed key at exactly one occurrence (verified by smoke). chmod 600 applied both before and after `mv` (mv adopts source mode, so post-mv chmod is the load-bearing one). `set -e` inside the remote heredoc + the runner's default `bash -eo pipefail` propagate any failure as a non-zero ssh exit. Workflow fails fast on env-write failure rather than continuing to pip install.
Notice now reads 'next 12:00 МСК cron tick' — operator gets a correct expectation. Manual tick command (`python3 -c 'from news_bot import job; job()'`) and rollback instructions preserved.

Files deployed list explicitly groups the four llm-transcreation additions together. ux-guidelines.md gets a Decision 8 note about the flat-fallback path so the operator doesn't search for it inside a subdir on the server. GitHub Secrets section names ANTHROPIC_API_KEY with the exact source URL (console.anthropic.com). GitHub Variables section names ANTHROPIC_MODEL/TZ with documented defaults — operator can leave them unset and the deploy still succeeds with safe defaults.

Pre-Deploy Checklist enumerates all required env vars including ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, mentions the bot_state migration (idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS), and reminds about ux-guidelines.md flat-or-subdir presence. Cost Monitoring section gives Anthropic console URL, expected cost band ($3/mo Haiku, $15/mo Sonnet), and a sanity threshold (~$1/day for a week) tied back to AC20 backlog warning + manual sqlite remediation. Operator gets a self-contained runbook for cost surprise.

Closes AC28: ux-guidelines.md was operator-side-only before this feature; the doc now explicitly records the architectural shift to cron-side runtime dependency, with the four new deploy-bundle files listed as a single 'cron-side files added by llm-transcreation feature' checklist for future reference. Closes AC27 implicitly (file is in the deploy bundle).
